changes.name: FixedOrbRewards
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("SkyCoins")
local busy={}
for _,coin in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
 if coin:IsA("BasePart") then coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not p or busy[coin] then return end
  local stats=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local c=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
  if not c then return end
  busy[coin]=true
  c.Value+=1000000
  coin.Transparency=1;coin.CanTouch=false
  local l=coin:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight");if l then l.Enabled=false end
  task.delay(7,function() if coin.Parent then coin.Transparency=0;coin.CanTouch=true;if l then l.Enabled=true end;busy[coin]=nil end end)
 end) end
end
